The flag-sync invalid-key errors, the notif-worker NUL-byte poison message (#2216, #2626) and the status-poller legacy-inventory timeouts are separate issues outside the ingest path.

Fix the restore procedure so it sets the sequence from the snapshot's max id. Confirm POST /v1/events succeeds afterward. Separately, skip or quarantine the NUL-byte message msg-286485 at offset 346800 in notif-worker, and follow up on the flag-sync invalid-key reloads and the legacy-inventory healthcheck timeouts.
